The pile is about 11 cm across and perhaps 3 cm high, so its volume is roughly 150 ml. Whole almonds pack loosely, with a bulk density of about 0.6 g/ml, which gives about 90 g. Counting the almonds, I see around 60–70 on top, and an almond weighs about 1.2 g, so the visible count suggests about 80–100 g once the hidden ones underneath are included. I'll use 85 g.

Almonds have about 5.8 kcal/g, so 85 g is about 490 kcal.
